reason: Verification failed on critical specification gaps and a major logic bug. With only three iterations left, a focused pass can still deliver the required metrics, fix the daily state logic, align/mapping parameters to the spec, and minimally adapt entities. These changes are high-impact and feasible within one iteration, enabling the simulation to pass verification and yield comparable outputs.

specific_areas: Implement all required metrics with exact spec names: time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption_rate, steady_state_adoption_rate (last 20%), mandate_effect_size (counterfactual), adoption_inequality_index (CV or Gini across groups), noncompliance_under_mandate.
Fix daily wearing logic: reset is_wearing_mask each day based on fresh willingness and inventory; tie consumption to actual wearing; if inventory hits zero, immediately set wearing to False.
Add parameter mapping layer to accept spec parameter names and validate inputs; warn/error on unknown or missing required fields.
Integrate policy cost into utility: include expected penalty (enforcement_probability * fine_amount) normalized by each agent’s budget/income.
Retail purchase limits: implement per-agent per-day purchase_limit_per_person, with daily counters reset.
Observational norms within locations: compute and update local_norm_compliance daily and include it in the wearing decision.

Minimal entity alignment/adapters: rename or alias to PolicyAuthority, Retailer, and Location attributes (mask_requirement_level, public_visibility, open_hours) and expose required methods; ensure fine amount and enforcement resources influence behavior.
Mandate effect counterfactual: optional second run with mandate disabled to compute mandate_effect_size; keep seeds aligned and time horizon identical.
MediaChannel enhancements: add credibility, bias, messaging_frequency_per_week, and message_effect_size; fold into broadcast influence.
Cleanup: remove unused imports or implement optional CLI/plotting; add docstrings and basic unit tests for metrics and mapping.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan a minimal-but-sufficient alignment layer: adapters or renames for PolicyAuthority/Retailer/Location; design the counterfactual run for mandate_effect_size; outline daily decision pipeline with norms, enforcement, and costs.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement the daily reset logic, parameter mapping, and new metrics. Add per-day purchase tracking and local norms update. Ensure per-agent budget is used in utility.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Verify metric values are plausible and consistent across runs; compare with baseline/no-mandate counterfactual; ensure steady-state windowing and inequality index are reported correctly.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide clear warnings/errors for unknown parameters and defaults used. Document metric definitions and assumptions in the output metadata or logs.
